label: Before It Hits the Ground: A

lines.text: In front of the Surface Elevator.
All of us have gone up to the surface together:

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: All the renowned fighting squads are here in one place...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Is it just me, or does it feel like we don't deserve to be here?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We don't have much time, so I'll quickly go over the operation.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: will be escorting School Circle and NERV to the mission area.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Once they arrive, they will set up a perimeter and cover them until the operation is complete.
Misato looks at the NERV members and School Circle Squad.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: It's just like Marciana mentioned back at the school.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: You'll move quickly to the operation area with the help of the Nikke squads,

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: and then intercept the Bunker Buster using the strategies you practiced.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: Are all those Nikkes over there

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: the ones who will be escorting us?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: will set up here and monitor the situation, providing guidance and instruction for all three teams.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The Counters Squad will guard this location.
Absolute will be going with Rei.A and Ein.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Looking forward to working with you!
Matis will take Asuka and Zwei.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Have no fear, your hero is here!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Don't worry, you've got a villain in your corner, mwahaha!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: *Sigh*... Can't you two at least TRY to act normal for a while?
Cafe Sweety, you'll be escorting Mari and Rei.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: We better get well compensated for this.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: How do you intend on taking us there?

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Do you have military vehicles, perhaps?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero doesn't need anything like that.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Our legs do just fine for running headlong towards justice.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: So what's the point of you all tagging along?

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: We could go on foot on our own!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Like we said, we're acting as escorts.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Going together will allow us to get through

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: the parts of the surface which are covered in Raptures.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We don't have any time to waste.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Everyone hurry and get into position.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Let's go, heroes! Full speed ahead!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I can't lose! Wait for me!
Matis takes off running with Asuka and Zwei in tow.
Absolute takes off with Rei.A and Ein.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: So we don't have to walk?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That's right. This is much faster.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Now this is more like it!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The rest of you will have to hoof it, though.
Sugar peels off on her motorcycle carrying Rei and Mari with her.
Frima and Milk run after Sugar and the others.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We should get going as well.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: This is Absolute. We've arrived at the location.

lines.speaker: ce004_04_op
lines.text: Location confirmed. Proceed with interception and defense.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Whew... We actually ran all the way out here.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Both of you, keep your attention focused on that Bunker Buster.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: We'll take care of these guys.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What the... where did those things come from?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Once you start messing around with that Bunker Buster, more will come.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Just like Eunhwa said, take care of the Bunker Buster.
Absolute heads out to fend off the approaching Raptures.
Rei.A notices the Bunker Buster falling from the sky.
It is surrounded by aerial-type Raptures, which seem to be protecting it.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'm already feeling overwhelmed. All right, Rei.A, let's start from the front.

lines.speaker: marciana_op
lines.text: Location confirmed. Proceed with interception and defense.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Whew... Still, we got here quickly thanks to you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: No need to thank me. That's merely what we do.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero in training, and a hero from another world.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Please take care of the Bunker Buster.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Unfortunately, we're powerless against it at the moment.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: In exchange, we will protect with our lives if need be!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: None of these villains will be able to lay a finger on you.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You must protect the Ark from these dastardly villains' plan.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: There's no way we'll fail. Isn't that right, Zwei?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'm glad to hear it! Very reassuring.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Stop pestering those two and come do your job!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: No more interference, then! Heroic deployment!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Oh no you don't! Villainous deployment!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: No matter how overwhelming it may feel, just keep your head down and do your best.
The Matis Squad moves out to fend off the approaching Raptures.
Asuka looks up at the Bunker Buster plummeting from the sky.
Milk and Frima arrived, panting heavily.
Sugar points to the Bunker Buster falling from the sky.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If you don't mind, could you take care of that?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: We may not be able to take care of the airborne ones near the Bunker Buster itself,

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: but we'll be able to hold off the ones

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: that will be attracted by the noise you're about to make.
Frima and Sugar leave to fend off the approaching Raptures.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Hey, wait for me, you rascals!

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Now then, waddya say we blow up this here Bunker Buster?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: You're right! We can do this!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That thing won't fall so long as we have anything to say about it.
